metadata.title: AC 21-day followed by weekly Paclitaxel (AC-T)
metadata.indication: neoadjuvant or adjuvant high-risk breast cancer

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
audit_limitations: Doxorubicin integer-labelled20–50 and51–86 bands leave continuous-value gap50<bilirubin<51; use explicit review/rounding-policy confirmation. No AST reduction is printed in this updated table.
CrCl10–29 and>=30 integer-labelled bands leave29<CrCl<30 undefined for continuous values; confirm clinical rounding/band interpretation instead of silently treating as normal.

Paclitaxel bilirubin bands leave1.25<ratio<1.26 and2<ratio<2.01 gaps. Both ALT and bilirubin are needed for a numerical hepatic dose; either high exclusion alone remains actionable. Missing ALT must not infer ALT<10.
Educational / software source reconciliation is not consultant, pharmacy or clinical-use authorisation.

source_monitoring.blood_repeat: FBC/renal/liver profile listed as regular tests; exact frequency not quantified in PDF
source_monitoring.baseline_echo: Source groups ECG/MUGA/ECHO with age>65years and clinically-indicated wording; LVEF>50% for doxorubicin. Syntax ambiguous.
source_monitoring.disease_monitoring: Treatment-plan/consultant-directed; no fixed CT/marker schedule stated

metadata.schedule_summary: Four AC cycles 21 days apart, followed by 12 weekly paclitaxel doses. The team confirms recovery and the transition appointment.
metadata.dose_level_context: Paclitaxel source reduction ladder 80 / 65 / 50 mg/m². The toxicity-specific action determines whether it applies; neuropathy and hepatic instructions differ.

renal_input.reason: Retain exact measured creatinine clearance so decimal gaps between the source bands are surfaced for review rather than rounded into a dose band.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded action was triggered by the supplied values. Unassessed domains and the full prescribing review remain outstanding.
output_templates.coverage_gap: Only entered values were assessed. Missing phase, history or results are not assumed normal.
output_templates.consultant_review: Review the component-specific findings and source uncertainty before treatment.
output_templates.contraindicated: Do not administer the affected component(s); review the findings and exact regimen context.
output_templates.discontinue: Discontinue the affected component(s) identified below and obtain treating-clinician review.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold the affected component(s) and assess the reported problem.
output_templates.delay: Delay the affected component(s) pending source-defined recovery and review.
output_templates.dose_reduce: A component-specific dose modification applies; verify the original and current doses before prescribing.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Return the most restrictive applicable action and display every triggered rule.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Evaluate supplied values independently. Missing values remain unassessed; never infer normality or phase.
